about.heading: Hey there, I am Thinh, a UI/UX designer polishing ideas until they shine
content: I've spent 6+ years designing consumer-facing products, from high-stakes commerce flows to complex logistics dashboards. My process starts with research, moves through systems thinking, and ends in interfaces that earn trust under real-world pressure.
I don't just follow briefs, I reframe them. Good design, to me, begins before the first pixel and persists long after the last release.
